string.text: "100 TIPS FOR SURVIVING IN THE ZONE"
A bullet in the eye is fatal, regardless of the level of armor protection.
AC96/2 has a unique firing mode with a two-round cut-off.In this mode, both bullets fired hit the same point.
Double-barreled shotguns can fire two shots almost simultaneously.
Don't underestimate pistols.They have a high lethal effect and are very effective against weakly armored opponents.
Sniper rifles, due to their high flexibility and accuracy, are ideal for destroying opponents at long distances.However, they are not as effective in close combat.
Shooting while moving is significantly less accurate than shooting from a stable standing or sitting position.

In the harsh conditions of the Zone, weapons and protective overalls quickly wear out.A worn-out weapon shoots less accurately and begins to misfire, and a worn-out jumpsuit loses its protective properties.
To take a screenshot, press the «$$ACTION_SCREENSHOT$$» key
The artifact or the player carrying it is displayed on the minimap.If an artifact is far away, the direction to it is displayed with an arrow on the minimap.
AS-96/2 has a unique firing mode with a two-round cut-off.In this mode, both bullets fired hit the same point.
Double-barreled shotguns can fire two shots almost simultaneously.
Don't underestimate pistols.They have a high lethal effect and are very effective against weakly armored opponents.
Sniper rifles, due to their high flexibility and accuracy, are ideal for destroying opponents at long distances.However, they are not as effective in close combat.

In the harsh conditions of the Zone, weapons and protective overalls quickly wear out.A worn-out weapon shoots less accurately and begins to misfire, and a worn-out jumpsuit loses its protective properties.

Some medications have unique properties - such as the Hercules drug, which allows you to temporarily increase the load you can carry, or a psi-blockade drug that increases resistance to effects on the psyche.
To take a screenshot, press the «$$ACTION_SCREENSHOT$$» key
Tip no.
Vodka is a cheap alternative to anti-radiation drugs and the most affordable way to reduce the effects of radiation on the body.
Details of the current task can be found by holding "$$ACTION_SCORES$$".
The detector is necessary to search for artifacts.Better detectors make searching easier and help uncover more valuable artifacts.
Stalkers do not allow people with weapons at the ready into the camp.To hide a weapon, press the corresponding key («$$ACTION_WPN_1$$», «$$ACTION_WPN_2$$», «$$ACTION_WPN_3$$», «$$ACTION_WPN_4$$»).
The boundaries of the anomaly can be determined by «probing» them with bolts.To prepare a bolt for throwing, press "$$ACTION_WPN_6$$".
Food not only satisfies hunger, but also somewhat improves health.
The energy drink temporarily speeds up stamina recovery, which increases potential mobility.
Lack of stamina can result in loss of mobility at a critical moment and make you vulnerable to the enemy.
The degree of visibility to the outside eye can be controlled using noise and visibility indicators.Both indicators are located in the upper left corner of the screen.
The detector in one hand does not interfere with taking a knife, gun or bolt in the other.
Some medications increase the body's resistance to harmful influences and may be the only salvation during forays into anomalous areas.
For items in the backpack, you can call up an additional context menu by hovering the cursor over the desired item and pressing the right mouse button.
Despite all the useful properties, most artifacts are radioactive.This effect can be compensated for by artifacts that absorb radiation.
The knife is ineffective against enemies armed with firearms.Its area of application is hand-to-hand combat and silent elimination of the enemy.
The amount of cargo carried directly affects the reduction in stamina.Heavy weight will limit mobility, and overload will not allow you to move at all.
The detector is the only reliable way to check for artifacts in an anomalous area.
Most artifacts migrate within anomalies and are not visible to the eye until they are detected using a detector.
Night is the time when mutants are active, so stalkers prefer to make forays during daylight hours.

In case of strong radiation exposure, it is necessary to use anti-radiation drugs or consult a doctor.If this is not possible, you can use a first aid kit to urgently reduce the negative effects of radiation on the body.

Most stalkers can guide them around the surrounding area, but only an experienced guide will lead them to remote places quickly and safely.In any case, guides usually value their services at a considerable amount.
Profit can be brought not only by artifacts, but also by selling surplus equipment.Please note that merchants will not pay the full cost of the equipment and will not buy damaged items.
To disconnect a silencer, optical sight or grenade launcher installed on a weapon, you need to right-click on the weapon icon in the backpack and use the corresponding command in the context menu.
To avoid making unnecessary noise, you can move by walking by pressing «$$ACTION_ACCEL$$», or crouching by pressing «$$ACTION_CROUCH$$».
The shotgun is a short-range weapon: the further away the target is, the less effective its use will be.

When choosing shelter from bullets, it is necessary to take into account the material of the barrier.A wooden board or thin sheet metal will not provide reliable protection - unlike a reinforced concrete wall.
A direct bullet hit to the head is fatal to most opponents.
Each type of mutant in the Zone has its own style of defense and attack.By taking this into account, you can significantly increase your chances of survival.
The grenade throw range can be adjusted by holding "$$ACTION_WPN_ZOOM$$".
Opponents can - and will - actively use grenades.If you notice a grenade symbol on the screen, immediately leave the expected affected area.
Using a running jump, you can overcome large holes and cracks.
Key indicators - health and stamina - are located in the lower right corner of the screen.
The zone lives its own life.This means that there is always a chance to meet a mutant or a hostile stalker in an already cleared area.
In the Zone, one must not lose vigilance and rely on old information.Finding yourself in a certain anomalous zone again, you may find that it cannot be overcome along the previous route.
By communicating with ordinary stalkers, you can learn useful information about new places or events that have happened recently.

Cells for placing weapons allow you to use any type of weapon.Try to choose the combination that is most convenient for you: machine gun and shotgun, pistol and sniper rifle, machine gun and grenade launcher, etc.
Each merchant in the stalker camp can offer his own special range of goods.Let's say that the doctor will probably have the best choice of medications.
If you find yourself in a stalker camp with radiation or a wound, you can count on free help from the local doctor.
In order not to carry extra cargo with you, you can leave your belongings in a personal box on the camp site.As a rule, such boxes are located near recreation areas.
If you need to pass the time until a certain hour, you can take a nap in the camp.To do this, find a place to rest, click «$$ACTION_USE$$» and select the duration of sleep.
The basic night vision device on a helmet can be replaced with a more advanced second-generation device, the resolution of which is much higher.
In the Zone, it is always better to have a couple of spare magazines with you, since they may be needed at any time.
Periodically saving the game can save a lot of time, since if you die, you won't have to go through the same places again.
To use medications rationally, it is necessary to know their properties.Carefully read the description of each drug.
To reach the enemy in cover, you can use a grenade.In this case, it is necessary to take into account the radius of damage from the blast wave and fragments so as not to harm allies.

To throw an item out of your backpack, you need to right-click on the desired item and use the corresponding command in the context menu.You can also simply drag the item to the left side of the screen.
A separate item in the game settings allows you to enable automatic saving of the game at key points.
After returning to the camp, it is recommended to repair equipment, sell unnecessary artifacts and replenish supplies of ammunition and medicine.
To reduce the harmful effects on the body during forays into anomalous zones, you can improve your protective suit, use the protective properties of artifacts, or use appropriate medications.
In addition to ammunition and weapons, other valuable items can be found on the corpses of opponents, such as a PDA with important information.
Artifacts are not just valuable goods; they often have useful properties.
In the Zone, many objects have an increased background radiation; approaching them without appropriate protection is dangerous.
To stop bleeding, you can use a bandage, an army first aid kit, or the drug "Periwinkle".Bleeding that is not stopped in time can cause significant damage to the body and result in death.
Some weapons may be equipped with an adjustable rangefinder sight.To adjust the aiming distance, use the mouse wheel.
Some places do not allow movement even in a bent position.To crouch as low as possible, press "$$ACTION_CROUCH$$" and "$$ACTION_ACCEL$$" at the same time.
To reduce the likelihood of being hit by enemy fire, you can shoot while looking around the corner.To do this, you need to hold down "$$ACTION_LLOOKOUT$$" or "$$ACTION_RLOOKOUT$$".
Thanks to the built-in target designator, the binoculars allow you not only to view distant objects, but also to detect the enemy among them.To remove the binoculars, press «$$ACTION_WPN_5$$».
To turn the flashlight on and off, press «$$ACTION_TORCH$$».
To remove the bolt, press "$$ACTION_WPN_6$$".
You can turn on and off the night vision device built into the helmet by clicking «$$ACTION_NIGHT_VISION$$».
Pressing "$$ACTION_QUICK_USE_1$$", "$$ACTION_QUICK_USE_2$$", "$$ACTION_QUICK_USE_3$$" or "$$ACTION_QUICK_USE_4$$" allows you to use the corresponding item on the quick access panel.
The effect of taking medications is not immediate, and some have a very long-lasting effect.Repeated administration of the drug overrides similar effects already in effect.
The PDA stores a map of the area, information about current tasks, personal statistics and message history.To activate the PDA, click «$$ACTION_ACTIVE_JOBS$$».
To search for artifacts, you need to get a detector.To do this, click "$$ACTION_SHOW_DETECTOR$$".
To pause the game, click "$$ACTION_PAUSE$$".
Running is the fastest form of movement, although it leads to a rapid loss of stamina.To switch to this type of movement, click «$$ACTION_SPRINT_TOGGLE$$».
In aiming mode, bullets hit the target much more accurately than when shooting offhand.To use the crosshair, click "$$ACTION_WPN_ZOOM$$".
If the weapon has an under-barrel grenade launcher, switching between the grenade launcher and normal firing modes is done by pressing «$$ACTION_WPN_FUNC$$».
If there are several types of ammunition for the current weapon, the desired type is selected by pressing «$$ACTION_WPN_NEXT$$».
To reload a weapon without waiting for the ammo in the magazine to be completely depleted, press "$$ACTION_WPN_RELOAD$$".
To drop your current weapon, press "$$ACTION_DROP$$".
You can safely wait out the release in a reliable building or underground.As a release approaches, the location of the nearest cover will be displayed on the PDA.
To quickly use an item, you need to drag it from the contents of the backpack to one of the four quick access slots.
The blood drop symbol in the lower right corner of the screen warns of uncontrolled bleeding.The color of the symbol indicates the intensity of bleeding.
The radiation hazard symbol in the lower right corner of the screen warns of radiation exposure to the body.The color of the symbol indicates the intensity of the radiation.
Using filters in the PDA, you can hide and show various types of marks on the map.Filter control buttons are located between the map image and the active task line.
Typically, artifacts are not static and gradually move within anomalous zones.As a result of mindlessly following an artifact, you can easily fall into an anomaly.
Some stalkers may offer information, a unique product for sale, or provide an order for a specific artifact.
After a release, new artifacts may appear in already explored areas.
The difficulty level of the game can be adjusted at any time in the settings.
The properties of a weapon, protective suit or helmet can be improved by technicians in stalker camps.
Pay attention to the crackling sound of the Geiger counter - it signals radiation.React to an anomalous danger signal that begins to sound close to the anomaly.

Relationships with others directly affect the price of the goods and services they offer.If your relationship is bad, you shouldn't hope for discounts;good relationships, on the contrary, will push the merchant to offer a unique product for sale.
To replenish your ammo supply, unload the weapon you find.To do this, you need to right-click on the image of the weapon in the backpack, and then select the appropriate command in the context menu.
For killing opponents and obtaining artifacts, you are awarded points necessary for rank growth.Upon reaching the next rank, new weapons, armor and equipment become available.
Smoke grenades can be used to secretly steal an artifact or to hide from an enemy.

On the left side of the shopping menu there are five tabs (from top to bottom): pistols, main weapons, equipment, ammunition, medicine.Selecting the desired tab demonstrates the assortment available for the current game rank.

In the purchase menu on the right side of the screen there are four quick purchase slots.Clicking on the floppy disk image saves the current set of weapons and equipment, and clicking the corresponding number loads it.The last purchased set is automatically saved in the fourth slot.
If you have more than one weapon, you can switch between them by repeatedly pressing «$$ACTION_WPN_2$$» or «$$ACTION_WPN_3$$».

An artifact can be activated by creating an anomaly in its place.To do this, you need to extract the artifact by clicking «$$ACTION_ARTEFACT$$» and click «$$ACTION_WPN_FIRE$$».The resulting anomaly is dangerous both for opponents and for the creator and his team.
The SEVA overalls will help you survive in an anomaly or zone of radioactive contamination.
«ARTIFACT HUNT»: To win, you need to deliver a certain number of artifacts to your base.

To disconnect a silencer, optical sight or grenade launcher installed on a weapon, you need to right-click on the weapon image in the contents of the backpack and use the corresponding command in the context menu.
To avoid making unnecessary noise, you can move by walking by pressing «$$ACTION_ACCEL$$», or crouching by pressing «$$ACTION_CROUCH$$».
The shotgun is a short-range weapon: the further away the target is, the less effective its use will be.

When choosing shelter from bullets, it is necessary to take into account the material of the barrier.A wooden board or thin sheet metal will not provide reliable protection - unlike a reinforced concrete wall.
A direct bullet hit to the head is fatal to most opponents.
Accelerated movement, jumping and wounds significantly reduce your stamina.
The force of the grenade throw can be adjusted by holding "$$ACTION_WPN_ZOOM$$".
Opponents can - and will - actively use grenades.If you notice a grenade symbol on the screen, immediately leave the expected area affected by shrapnel.
DEATH MATCH: To win, you must score the most kills.
Using a running jump, you can overcome large holes and cracks.
Key indicators - health and stamina - are located in the lower right corner of the screen.
The mini-map schematically shows the position of the artifact relative to the player.If the arrow points up, the artifact is located above the player's position, if down, the artifact is below.
You can pick up the backpacks of the dead to earn extra money.Excess collected equipment can be sold at the base.
An ally who is carrying an artifact must be covered at all costs.
To reach the enemy in cover, you can use a grenade.In this case, it is necessary to take into account the radius of damage from the blast wave and fragments so as not to accidentally hit an ally.
You can maintain constant communication with your team using voice messages.The message menu is called up by pressing «$$ACTION_SPEECH_MENU_0$$» or «$$ACTION_SPEECH_MENU_1$$».
TEAM VS TEAM: To win, team members must score more kills than the opposing team.
Voting is initiated by pressing «$$ACTION_VOTE_BEGIN$$».
To view the game results, you must click «$$ACTION_SCORES$$».
To respawn after dying, press "$$ACTION_JUMP$$" after the timeout has expired.
To open the shopping menu, click «$$ACTION_BUY_MENU$$» while within the base.
General text chat can be opened by pressing "$$ACTION_CHAT$$".To chat only with members of your team, use "$$ACTION_CHAT_TEAM$$".
Running is the fastest form of movement, although it leads to a rapid loss of stamina.To switch to this type of movement, click «$$ACTION_SPRINT_TOGGLE$$».
In aiming mode, bullets hit the target much more accurately than when shooting offhand.To use the crosshair, click "$$ACTION_WPN_ZOOM$$".
If the weapon has an under-barrel grenade launcher, switching between the grenade launcher and normal firing modes is done by pressing «$$ACTION_WPN_FUNC$$».
If there are several types of ammunition for the current weapon, the desired type is selected by pressing «$$ACTION_WPN_NEXT$$».
To reload a weapon without waiting for the ammo in the magazine to be completely depleted, press "$$ACTION_WPN_RELOAD$$".
«ARTIFACT CAPTURE»: To win, you need to deliver a certain number of enemy artifacts to your base.
To drop your current weapon, press "$$ACTION_DROP$$".
To view the contents of your backpack, click "$$ACTION_INVENTORY$$".
Automatic weapons allow you to fire in two or three modes.To switch between modes, use "$$ACTION_WPN_FIREMODE_NEXT$$" or "$$ACTION_WPN_FIREMODE_PREV$$".
Some places do not allow movement even in a bent position.To crouch as low as possible, press "$$ACTION_CROUCH$$" and "$$ACTION_ACCEL$$" at the same time.
To peek around a corner, click "$$ACTION_LLOOKOUT$$" or "$$ACTION_RLOOKOUT$$".Please note that it is impossible to fire in this position.
«ARTIFACT CAPTURE»: To return the stolen artifact to the base, you need to kill the enemy carrying the artifact and pick up the latter by pressing «$$ACTION_USE$$».
«ARTIFACT HUNT»: An artifact can be destroyed by activating it.To do this, you need to get the artifact by pressing «$$ACTION_ARTEFACT$$», and then clicking «$$ACTION_WPN_FIRE$$».
While carrying an artifact, running is not possible.
To view the contents of your backpack, click "$$ACTION_INVENTORY$$".
To repair a weapon, suit or helmet, you need to find a technician and, by selecting the desired item in the upgrade window, click on the repair button.
Automatic weapons allow you to fire in several modes.To switch between firing modes, use "$$ACTION_WPN_FIREMODE_NEXT$$" or "$$ACTION_WPN_FIREMODE_PREV$$".
Flatness is a weapon parameter that affects the flight path of a bullet, and convenience affects the speed at which the sight returns to its original position.
Some suits come with integrated helmets.Wearing other helmets with such suits is impossible.
Each weapon has its own unique characteristics of accuracy, usability, damage and rate of fire.This allows everyone to choose the most suitable sample.
When going on a long trip, you need to take a supply of food with you.Severe hunger negatively affects stamina and health.
The accuracy of firing while moving is significantly lower than from a more stable position - standing or sitting.
The energy drink temporarily speeds up the process of restoring endurance, which allows you to increase the average duration of your run.
In the game mode "All against all" the supply of ammunition is unlimited.
One of the most common dangers in the Zone is radiation.Strong exposure to radiation leads to deterioration of health, and without proper treatment, even death.
